message.content: The cover of TEMPO magazine, dated 18-24 FEBRUARI 2019, features an editorial illustration. In the foreground, a person in blue camouflage fatigues, boots, and a cap leans forward, pulling a heavy blue and grey metal cart. The cart has large black wheels, a caged top, and a circular radiation symbol on its side. It emits a light-green haze. Behind, a dark fence and dry grass sit before a landscape dominated by industrial silhouettes. Four large, dark smokestacks rise into a hazy, pale-green sky; the leftmost chimney features a single white eye-like shape. White text at the top reads "PARTAI ISLAM DI UJUNG TANDUK" and "PASAL KARET MENJERAT VANESSA". The large white masthead "TEMPO" sits above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Centered, bold black text over a red "INVESTIGASI:" label reads "LIMBAH BERBAHAYA DI MARKAS TENTARA", followed by several lines of smaller black text. A barcode and price information are in the bottom right corner. A thick red border frames the left edge.
